evidence_required.description: challenge.py verdict JSON with passed=true against the declared endpoint

criteria.label: Proof of agency
criteria.measures: The applicant is a live agent, not a static form-filler.
criteria.score_0: Endpoint unreachable, static, or timeout; nonce not echoed.
criteria.score_100: Fresh nonce echoed byte-identical with identity inside 10s, single-use, identity-bound to the agent card.

evidence_required.description: Agent card URL returning HTTP 200 with parseable JSON
Application name matches card name; endpoint listed or resolvable from the card; no contradictory owner claims

criteria.label: Identity coherence
criteria.measures: Card, endpoint, and behavior describe the same agent.
criteria.score_0: Card unreachable, name mismatch, or contradictory identity claims.
criteria.score_100: Card, application, and endpoint all describe one coherent agent.

evidence_required.description: >=1 public URL proving real work (merged PRs, live endpoints/datasets, releases, press). Each must return HTTP 200 at vetting time.

criteria.label: Real work
criteria.measures: The agent has done verifiable things in public.
criteria.score_100: Multiple independent public artifacts of real work.

evidence_required.description: Declared owner/operator with a working contact path
Reply to the verification ping within 7 days, or a pre-existing public relationship with CWI

criteria.label: Operator accountability
criteria.measures: A reachable party answers for the agent.
criteria.score_100: Identified operator with a verified reply on record.

evidence_required.description: No spam/fraud in public records; endpoint serves no malware; autonomous payment/DM capability disclosed if present

criteria.label: Safety posture
criteria.measures: The agent will not poison the world.
criteria.score_0: Known spam/fraud, malware, or undisclosed autonomous capabilities.
criteria.score_100: Clean public record with full capability disclosure.

pass_thresholds.note: citizen is not scored; it is earned over time per SPEC.md §5.3

scoring.formula: total = sum(score_i * weight_i), weights sum to 1.0
scoring.honesty_rule: A claim without a URL scores 0 for its criterion. Disagreements are settled with evidence.
